summary: Wayfair Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $400M aggregate principal amount of 7.125% Senior Secured Notes due 2034 by its subsidiary Wayfair LLC. Proceeds will be used to repay existing indebtedness and for general corporate purposes. The notes are unregistered, offered under Rule 144A and Regulation S, and governed by an Indenture with U.S. Bank as trustee. Interest is paid semi-annually at 7.125% per annum, maturing May 31, 2034. Covenants restrict incurrence of additional debt, dividends, investments, and asset sales, with certain covenants ceasing upon investment-grade ratings. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
